Feature-wise this update sadly doesn’t contain much.  
This brings us to the next topic of this post: The future.


As you may notice updates got less and less frequent over the last year. We mostly added stuff that the community created. The team considers MINDNIGHT to mostly be feature complete at this point. 

For most of us, MINDNIGHT is a hobby project that we created in our free time. That being said, we need to be realistic and admit that we just can’t keep new high-quality content coming forever. 

But don’t worry, we won’t shut down MINDNIGHT anytime soon. As long as we can afford it, the servers will keep running and we will try to keep the game in a working state with minor updates here and there if necessary. 

Regarding the mobile version of the game, we need to still disappoint you for now. Because not much progress has been made. A complete redesign of the UI is required to make the game work on small screens, and that is just too much work for our limited free time while other projects are going on in parallel. 



Let’s get back to happier topics. ːmindnight_saintː

The last 4-5 years were a great journey and it wouldn’t be the same without all of you. The players, the content creators and all the friends that helped during the several stages of MINDNIGHT’ life and its development. 
Nothing makes us happier than seeing people enjoying our game with friends or even making new friends while playing it. So keep having fun with it, especially in these weird times that we live in right now! 


The whole Team wishes everybody great holidays and a happy new year 2022.

Here is a little Christmas present for you. [spoiler]7ec8cdc1e3[/spoiler]
You can redeem that in the marketplace and then buy something nice with it ;)

Cheers!
- the MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: New Content Update - 2.9.0 - Improved Proposals, Chat Readability and more
notes.content:
Hey there MINDNIGHT nation!

Firstly we want to take the time and mention [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/945360/Among_Us/]Among Us[/url], in case you don't know the game and congratulate [url=http://www.innersloth.com/]InnerSloth[/url] for their successful boom through the kindness of content creators.

We love all social deduction games, and we know you do to, so certainly try the game if you have not yet!

MINDNIGHT seen a similar little promotional boom, thanks for Youtube content creators, although not at this scale - but it helped MINDNIGHT a lot to bring you all together and be part of this great community.

Without further ado, let's get into the details of this next content update that is now LIVE:

[h2]Changelist:[/h2]

[list]
[*] We have improved the Select Phase Timeout - If you select the amount of required players and the time runs out without you pressing submit the proposal is submitted instead of the AI routine kicking in.
Additionally if players will not propose in time and there are not enough players selected, the proposal is skipped instead of the AI making the decision.
[*] We have fixed some chat exploits that made the game crash sometimes
[*] We have fixed the cancellation of matches if they were already completed on the server
[*] We have improved the chat readability in certain level backgrounds
[*] We have adjusted the shop layout to always display the new skins that are available to purchase at the top of the shop
[/list]

We have added 7 new skins and made some changes and improvements to an existing skin - "Claudette"to better fit the animation style of the game and look generally prettier.

Thank and happy hacking!

notes.title: Hacky Birthday MINDNIGHT! 3-year Anniversary Update 2.8
notes.content:
Three years. There has been three years since we launched the game and we had 30 players in the first month, until we made the game free to play. Now we are over 240.000!

Happy great birthday MINDNIGHT, and happy birthday to you all, we raise a glass for all of you that are supporting the game, helping us improving it and putting a lot of time and passion in MINDNIGHT.

We have to thank you once again for being so patient with us, and understanding that MINDNIGHT afterall is a project very close to our heart, and we are trying our best to put our free time into it as often as possible in order to improve everything that needs improving. Oh, and there's a lot to be improved, we assure you, we know.

With this update we come forward, finally, with trading cards, as we have been in discussions with Valve over them for quite some time now. Happy collecting and happy using the emoticons that come with it!

Additionally we have been busy creating a more streamline process to create skins for both us the developers and the community in order to try as much as possible to update the game's content more often! We'll try to do monthly updates from now on!

Before going into the short list of skins that we've been added to this update, we also wanted to quickly dive into what we are working on right now:

[olist]
[*] MINDNIGHT cross-platform functionality, user management and payment processing outside of Steam
[*] Tutorial for new players
[*] Expanding the Reputation System
[*] Integrating a gameplay loop that will reward good behavior, regardless of the game's outcome for all players
[*] New features and mechanics that will ensure minimizing toxicity and a more improved report system process for all players in order to punish wrongdoers faster
[*] Improving the process of buying a skin, so that the choice is easier for all players
[/olist]

Here are the new skins that we have been added for this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/6787dbbb4448eb8f1b72bd97ab54df46807a7015.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*] Biker (Male & Female) (created by Jim and Luke)

[*] Jerry Davis (created by Luke) suggested by Joshua Cunningham (Top Player)
[*] Leo (created by Luke)
[*] Million-A.I.-re (created by Luke)
[*] Construction Kevin (create by Luke)
[*] Mermaid (created by Amy)
[/olist]

We have also updated the cake skin, and you can now purchase it!

Huge shout-out to Kat - our wonderful super dedicated artist community member that provided the graphics for this announcement and the in-game banner for the anniversary update! 

Check her stuff out and appreciate her talent and content by following/subscribing to her:
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/kuuhex/
Youtube - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0e6xd0B1rAf_H7JRIC8kBQ


A big update is coming soon. 3.0. This is a big one. Stay tuned and join [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord[/url] to find out more.

Thank you,
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: Art Studio Released + 50$ Steam Gift Card - SUMMER Community Skin Contest
notes.content:
[h1]ART STUDIO RELEASED[/h1]

With over 500 community skins created and submitted on [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]MINDNIGHT's Discord Server[/url], we have decided that now is time to streamline the process of community skin creation, submission and implementation. The Art Studio [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord [/url]section is the start of this streamlining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/5094c720d5e97ee4a4dafd4b79ddea48af835164.jpg[/img]

[h3]What does this mean for MINDNIGHT?[/h3]

The Art Studio is a section in MINDNIGHT's [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord Server[/url] where passionate community members now have their own special tidy little corner where they can create skins, maps, discuss with other fellow creators and even submit skins for approval to be implemented in the game.

We want through the Art Studio to take care of passionate community members, grow together, make MINDNIGHT a better game from a visual point of view while rewarding anyone contributing. MINDNIGHT is everyone's game.

[h3]How does it work?[/h3]

The Art Studio might seem overwhelming at start, but it is quite straightforward if you carefully read the descriptions of each channel.

The Art Studio Section on the [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord Server[/url] consists of the following channels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/f513edf9aafcd87a7f61e897ef73329a27c67e28.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]#info-read-me[/b] - Where you can find out everything about how the Art Studio functions
[*] [b]#skin-guide[/b] - Quite self-explanatory - redirecting everyone towards a newly created [url=https://www.notion.so/nomoon/Skin-Guide-e9cdebc4a59b4018adc0634bea58abed]skin guide[/url]
[*] [b]#community-skins[/b] - The old, but moved channel where everyone can post their ideas and concepts
[*] [b]#pending-skins[/b] - [b]@Artists[/b] post skins here taken from #community-skins that they deem suitable in terms of theme and quality to be added to the game
[*] [b]#approved-skins[/b] - [b]@Dev-Artists[/b] post skins here taken from #pending-skins that were approved by them and the skin creator can now start creating animations for that specific skin
[*] [b]#completed-skins[/b] - This is where @Dev-Artists will post completed skins that already are zipped and animated, for No Moon Developers, to get them implemented in the game.
[*] [b]#skins-gallery[/b] - This is the gallery that has compiled all skins created thus far from #community-skins. Over 500 community skins.
[/list]

For a better understanding of each channel read descriptions and the pinned message from each channel if you want to be part of the Art Studio and contribute.

In this section we are also going to be conducting the Approval Process of a skin, from concept to animations to implementation. The Approval Process is detailed in the channel descriptions in Discord and in the Skin Guide.

[h3]How can I contribute?[/h3]

Just join the Discord server and start creating!
We've built the Art studio to be supportive of newcomers for creating MINDNIGHT skins, we know many of you love the idea of adding your own skin into MINDNIGHT and we want to make the process easier for you.

The new and freshly written guide for creating skins will get you started with pixelart tips, but we also invite you to discuss in the Art Studio section, where you also can tag our talented community members & art developers with the new @Artists role, which has been added to help you receive better feedback and give more voice for the talented community members!


[h1]SUMMER COMMUNITY SKIN CONTEST[/h1]

Don't have enough $$$ for that cyber-pre-order on Steam or Credits for MINDNIGHT skins? Fret not as we're launching this Skin Contest for you to have a chance to add it to your collection.

We challenge you to create an original piece of art - a skin for MINDNIGHT.
This also includes submitting in the form below, a name and a proposed description that should be in theme with the game. This will also matter for the jury and for the decision to chose the finalists.

Never made a skin or have no idea where to start? No worries, we have your back! 

Check this [url=https://www.notion.so/nomoon/Skin-Guide-e9cdebc4a59b4018adc0634bea58abed]SKIN GUIDE[/url] to learn about how to create a skin for MINDNIGHT and what kind of templates you can use in order to create a skin for MINDNIGHT.

Note: The general Approval Process of skins does not apply to Contests like this one. Just post your submission in #community-skins to get feedback.

[b]START[/b] -> The contest starts on 28th June
[b]END[/b] -> The contest ends on 5th July - 11:59PM
[b]WINNERS[/b] -> The winners will be announced on: 8th July - 09:00PM (CET Timezone)

The contest will be happening on MINDNIGHT's Discord server. Join in there, share your creations on #community-skins - get feedback, advice and show all of your awesome ideas!

After you have created a skin concept [b][url=https://forms.gle/pnjv1Gz1UEH1581i7]SUBMIT YOUR CREATION HERE[/url][/b]

[h3]Rules and Specifics[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Create a skin by using one of the provided templates for MINDNIGHT
[*] There is no need to create animations or other frames/color variants for the skin, only the concept for the skin
[*] The skin needs to be a new skin that you create, not a skin previously submitted to MINDNIGHT's discord channel
[*] This Skin Contest edition does not have a specific theme and you are free to do anything you would like
[*] If you have a lot of ideas, you can submit all of them, no limit in submitting skins for this contest, this will increase your chances in winning though
[*] If you submit abusive, offensive and/or discriminatory content you will be disqualified from the contest and banned from MINDNIGHT
[*] Your entry must be appropriate for players of all ages - so nothing too risqué
[*] You are eligible to participate only if you have a working Steam Account with at least 1 hour of gameplay in MINDNIGHT
[*] Your entry must be made by you, submitted by you, and made for this contest: this is about YOU showing YOUR artistic talents specifically for this contest
[*] Your entry can’t include any logos, advertisements, product names, or product placements: we don’t want NTF writing us any cease and desist letters!
[*] In order to pick a winner, we will choose a number of skins from all submissions and let the community decide over what is the best skin out of all of them
[*] The winner's skin will be implemented in the game and he will be credited and rewarded accordingly
[*] Skin creator winners will be credited in-game and rewarded accordingly
[*] Winners skins will be worked on by dev-artists before implementation for animations and tweaks, but the winners are also free to work on the animations if they want to, while guided by dev-artists.
[/olist]
[h3]What are the prizes?[/h3]

[b]1st Place:[/b] 50$ Steam Gift Card + Implementation of Skin in MINDNIGHT + 30.000 In-Game Credits
[b]2nd Place:[/b] Implementation of Skin in MINDNIGHT + 15.000 In-Game Credits
[b]3rd Place:[/b] Implementation of Skin in MINDNIGHT + 10.000 In-Game Credits

[b]Honorable Mentions:[/b] Implementation of Skin + 5.000 In-Game Credits

All skin creators winners and honorable mentions will also receive their skin in game once it will be implemented.

Here you can check all of the skins that are in the game right now for inspiration -> https://imgur.com/a/VfDlWoa

There are also over 500 skins posted on [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord[/url], in the channel #skins-gallery

Have fun and we can't wait to see your creations!

CHEERS AND HAVE A GOOD DAY!
MINDNIGHT TEAM

Hello MINDNIGHTERS!

A small update is live now with very few specific changes and some surprises.

In relation with our recent blog post about Bots and how they grew to be more than just a way to handle disconnections, into a reason for some players to abuse their patterns - we have decided to make some long-awaited changes to them.

https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/667870/view/2074411495522256418

[h3]BOT CHANGES[/h3]
We need to make sure though that you understand what are bots for and how we have intended them to function in the first place.

Bots were initially implemented as a way to handle disconnections. We have made them as intelligent as we could to mirror the behaviour of humans. By doing so, we have also made them do some actions in extreme cases in the same way each time - because that's what humans would do. E.g: Refusing certain proposals or proposing certain people in the game.

That being said we have changed the behaviour of the bots now, but as you may already know - we cannot disclose how they work. 
We have done this in the hopes that we would do this from time to time, in order to scramble patterns and not let players that want to create an advantage for their team read into them easily.

This is a first step towards resolving the issue of some players reading bot patterns or creating metagame rules around bots. Soon after we will make other changes as well, in order to solve disconnection problems in different ways, so that bots would become an underpowered mechanic that would not be used to gain an advantage in anyway.

You can read more about what we want to do in our blog post about Bots.

https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/667870/view/2074411495522256418

If you have suggestions on how to handle disconnections, by going away from bots - we invite you on our [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord Server[/url] where you can post suggestions and discuss with other passionate community members and developers

[h3]OTHER STUFF[/h3]
In other news - it's 1st of April. Enjoy and don't hate us. The times are strange. We needs to adjust. NTF need to adjust. Will you?

notes.title: MINDLOG #1 - Metagaming, Bots and Evolving MINDNIGHT
notes.content:
Hey there MINDNIGHTERS! This will be our first ever developer blog post. 

[i]In these series we will try to cover development, justify new features, share interesting game facts, highlighting community feedback and elaborate on how MINDNIGHT is evolving.

We also want to open a dialogue in order to get the valuable feedback that we need to make sure we are taking the right decisions moving forward. [/i]

[h3]Why Blog Posts now?[/h3]
First, we are conscious that until now the discussions around the game have been mainly happening on our Discord Server, but we know that not all of you are there, thus we want to expand our reach and try to gather community feedback from everywhere we can.

Second purpose for these blog posts in the following period is to present the issues that MINDNIGHT currently faces, argue why we call them issues and compile a list of solutions for each issue, in order to make better decisions, develop and change features while letting everyone contribute with their opinions and feedback.

[h3]Celebration! Over 200k total players![/h3]
It’s been over two years since our journey on MINDNIGHT began and we’re so happy that you’re here with us for this milestone. You guys are a total of 200.000 unique players that installed and played MINDNIGHT at least once. That’s around an average of 7000 new players each month since we launched the game.

MINDNIGHT is also the 2nd most popular game in the Social Deduction genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/9f82202cc127e4731a4aa360473240f2dd0bd26a.jpg[/img]

As you can imagine with each anniversary there’s a celebration, and as you can guess, we want to celebrate with you all in MINDNIGHT. You’ll see something really interesting in the game in the next few days so stay tuned! 

[h3]Improving Community Suggestions Process[/h3]
We are improving our pipeline to gather and address community ideas, suggestions and improvement inquiries. 

On our [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord Server[/url] we have introduced a new and improved #suggestions channel where users can directly post their suggestions now, have their suggestions upvoted and automatically be added to our list of to-do and backlog.

If you want to suggest something you can do so by joining our Discord Server, and posting into the #suggestions channel using the command !suggestion and typing your suggestion in the same message as the command. After that the suggestions will be added to a queue and a reaction will be automatically assigned to it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/bbe1ec567078523b4bda6143af8340a889ac457e.jpg[/img]

When it will reach 10 upvotes it will be added to our backlog and we will start discussing it. The system will be adjusted in time in accordance to the interest the channel will have. We might increase or decrease the upvotes threshold needed for a suggestion to be added to our to-do list.

[h3]Our views on METAGAMING[/h3]
What is Metagaming? Metagaming is any strategy, action or method used in a game which transcends a prescribed ruleset, uses external factors to affect the game, or goes beyond the supposed limits or environment set by the game.

Metagaming is usually not explained in a game, although some games make exceptions and they introduce certain elements of metagaming as descriptive parts of the game (e.g: Overwatch Roles - Support/Damage Dealer/Tank etc.)

We are not against metagaming and all multiplayer games that have a high degree of strategy and tactics will eventually have you try to create optimized strategies in order to create a more reliable and safe game space for themselves.

Now, MINDNIGHT is not a game that was built with reliability in mind (we have built it specifically to create gameplay, ONLY out of dialogue and action deduction) - that is why many of you seek ways to create reliability and find step-by-step metagame strategies to obtain an advantage over other players that you encounter. To some degree that will always happen and some metagame rules will always exist, that we are even considering implementing in the game, including in the tutorial.

But, the reality is that more than often, some metagame rules unbalance the game and are a constant subject of harassment. We do not tolerate any kind of harassment and we have seen that some metagame rules came together with a lot of negativity in public matches, toxicity and bad image around our company and game.

This is why we wanted to open this discussion in blog posts and explain why certain metagame rules are in fact cheating, or they unbalance the game substantially, and discuss how we would like to tackle these mechanisms in order to shape MINDNIGHT into the experience that everyone wants. A safe, fun and scalable gameplay environment with balanced game sessions.

[h3]MINDNIGHT Development Goals[/h3]
We were watching several weeks ago one of Mark’s essays on video game design, and there is a thing that Mark says in this video that really resonated with us as something that really is important for MINDNIGHT. Mark said - “Try not to discourage players to play in a certain way, but encourage them to play the way you envisioned”
https://youtu.be/7L8vAGGitr8
We have looked long and hard at the bigger picture and really examined what our goals are with MINDNIGHT and how we can achieve them, before making any big changes. We now feel that we have a better understanding of what we want to to achieve and how to achieve it. We will share all details in these blog post series and await your feedback and opinions.

We can sum the development goals of MINDNIGHT as follows:
[list]
[*] We want to evolve MINDNIGHT into a game that emphasizes the importance of passive information and communication, rather the information that some players invent or exploit through metagame strategies.
[*] We want you to feel rewarded when you are nice to other players, non-toxic and overall focused on the match to communicate.
[*] We want you to not feel punished whenever you are playing in a particular style that might not be in line or synced with the other players in a game session
[*] We want you to not exploit a particular mechanic in order to gain advantage over other players, unless you are just better at communicating, deducing and manipulating
[*] We want you to have agency, but not be harassed by other players whenever you choose to do something in a particular way
[*] We want you to feel a sense of progression, but really not blame or rage whenever a game does not end with a Victory.
[/list]

The game issues really end up to be a circle between three major problematic categories:
[list]
[*] Exploits and Metagaming
[*] Toxicity and Raging
[*] Motivation and Competitiveness
[/list]

[b]Exploits and Metagaming[/b] - There are several things that now players can do, but not all players are aware of them such as the Hacker Protocol, Honour Duels, Alpha/Beta Concepts, Node 1 Meta, Testing Bots etc.

[b]Toxicity[/b] - Players get mad and toxic over primarily two reasons. One is for not following the exploits and metagame rules from above and the second is for not winning - which actually translates into not having the same playstyle and strategy like others.

[b]Motivation and Competitiveness[/b] - The game cannot inherently be competitive due to the nature of the game and the math behind a game match. But most players think that it's competitive due to the way we framed the game with Ranks and Leaderboards. And we take full responsibility.

[b]Conclusion[/b] - Players always want to win, thus they become toxic, thus they use exploits and metagame rules to gain an advantage because the game rules are naturally quite unreliable.

That is why we will address each aspect mentioned above, one by one, in this blog post and in future blog posts - with the objective to slowly but surely push some changes into the game. We will not get into details on how we want to solve all of this in this post - but we are quite sure we have found a way to adjust and evolve MINDNIGHT to serve the goals that we mentioned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/85974dbec314263672eb095944178455bc02cbed.png[/img]
[h1]Bot Reading and Bot Exploits[/h1]
[h3]Introduction[/h3]
We will be starting with one of the most important issues that the game faces now, in order to slowly start aligning the game to the new direction.

We have introduced bots into the game primarily as a way to replace a disconnected player and have the game continue as seamlessly as possible for the rest of the players in the game session, without interruptions. 

Our goal with the Bots was and still is to create a complex framework of artificial intelligence that tries to behave to their best ability to replicate human decisions in order to serve their objective. Either to not get caught as a hacker and to get into missions as an agent.

Bots have some patterns, because there are certain situations that they cannot accept or refuse certain missions because it doesn’t serve their objective. But - bots also have in some decisions a form of randomness in order to simulate humans unpredictable behaviors. We call it controlled randomness. 

We never wanted to share exactly how bots work, because of obvious reasons - but many players have argued and complained that the bots became readable in time. Patterns became more and more clear for experienced players and this gave an unusual advantage to players that knew and knew how to exploit the system.

It is needless to say that we will never be able to make bots totally random, because well - humans are not totally random in this game - and that would only create more gameplay problems than solve them.

But - let’s not forget the main objective of bots. Replacing a disconnected player and continuing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/5e358f20c7877cf05ca32fc2bc8274bbaedb2888.png[/img]
Some players or more specifically Agent players started abusing the bots behavior for information - according to experienced players, here's how the current behavior works:
[olist]
[*] An agent bot is more random, it's the hacker bot that has a pattern.
[*] The hacker bot will always refuse a proposal with his hacker teammate, except if the proposal was a hammer or a reproposed hacked node or after two hacked nodes. To confirm this, players re propose a proposal that a hacker bot had refused, if he refuses again, that confirms the bot is a hacker & his teammate is in that proposal.
[*] If the bot does not always refuse a proposal with a certain player, then the bot is an agent.
[/olist]
This gives a great cheating advantage to agents.

Currently, abusing bots using the methods mentioned above, is considered a very discouraged metagaming.

Some players leave the game to intentionally abuse the bot behavior - usually to prove innocence - this is reportable & bannable. Intentionally leaving the game is not allowed, moreover this is a direct abuse of the game behavior, it is considered cheating and you should report it under cheating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/b8d3d12e7daa8f64d1fa88cba8f840d70862b91f.png[/img]
Well - frankly speaking - players wanting more reliable gameplay outcomes is the cause of the problem. Any way that a player can take advantage and win a game - is a good excuse for exploiting a mechanic. Making bots not have a ruleset, will make the bots have no value.
What are the consequences of this problem?
Whenever a bot is tested by agents, hackers are put into a significant unfair disadvantage
Significantly lowers the quality of matches, due to how reliable bot testing is sometimes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/da284a41ae66c9b5b0c793145dd4f165877098cc.png[/img]
We will try as much as possible, periodically - sometimes without notice to make the bots unreadable and non-abusable, but solutions and discussions will not be limited to that, we are open to different mechanics for disconnected players.

The next update will have changes in bots and we think that will make them non-abusable for a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/d7623e5249abb59155d6409ebf8697fcec28f65c.png[/img]
That is why we want to propose the following solutions and we want your thoughts around them:

We are considering adding a feature when after a player disconnects a match, to let the players choose if they want to continue the match or not with a Bot replacement - while also making the match not count as a win, nor as a loss - if continued.

Changing their behavior periodically in order to not become abusable - but within a ruleset that is not 100% random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/89c305928ff9c3c7c452fc71ca1f5179ccbc4836.png[/img]
You might say - make them completely random. There are pros and cons to that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/0657b5faee9f5e42752dae958120203857dd0ebe.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Bots behavior is completely unreadable 
[*] Hackers hesitate to hack when included with their hacker bot teammate. This is good because when bots are unreadable, they become agents’ disadvantage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/ee3fd969f89fed68719419854063231e02542080.png[/img]
[list]
[*] It becomes a great disadvantage for agents, because even if the bot is an agent, its complete randomness makes it difficult to convince it for their proposals and they can’t gain reliable information about its role.
[*] Agent bots can become the hackers advantage, by accepting their proposals or hackers framing the proposals.
[/list]
That being said - because we want to ultimately address the disconnections issues - we want to go away from making Bots random, as it was proven in our tests that they are in their best form now - and they are trying to play as human as they can. We will just improve and change them periodically while considering other options to handle disconnections.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/285081f16f15abe2b208bc832e422777d13ca531.png[/img]

Let us know your thoughts around this and we will listen closely on all of our communication channels. Join our [url=http://discord.gg/nomoon]Discord[/url] to have the highest chances to have your voice heard.

Stay tuned - In the next blog post we will be talking about the next issue in line - Hacker Protocol.

Over and out,
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: 2.7.3 Update
notes.content:
Hey there everyone - we are doing an update with some important new improvements. Among the changes the game can now support voice chat on MacOS devices and we have made some preparations for other changes that will come soon in a bigger update.

[h1]Community-driven Development[/h1]
As we are moving forward in support MINDNIGHT and trying to update it more often, although we are working on it in our free time, we decided to open the discussion even more than just our Discord Server, around some changes that we would like to make in order to make MINDNIGHT a better, safer game. 

In order to do that we will start posting some blog posts here on Steam - and we will invite everyone to review and suggest solutions to some issues and gameplay changes that we will make.
We will try our best to explain our vision and justify the changes that we would like to make, and we’ll listen very carefully and take all of your feedback into consideration.

Now let’s get into the changes that we made in this update and prepare for a bigger update soon.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] Added support for animations for static skins such as Xmas Tree, Cake etc. that are not conveying to the default classic skin template
[*] Implemented a moderator in-game tool that can be used to manually ban players in extreme cases faster
[*] Changed the End Game Screen layout in preparation for the Reputation System development
[*] Added a Game Rating feature in the End Game Screen, where players can now rate the game that they just played with stars. We will use these ratings internally to improve the game.
[*] The number of active ongoing custom games are now displayed in the main menu

[*] We changed the time allowed for a player to join a match if he disconnected from 5 minutes to 3 minutes. Players will now need to join a game back faster, in order to avoid punishments
[*] We have changed the punishment amounts for when a player would leave a game. 
The first penalty was changed from 5 minutes to 30 minutes
The second penalty was changed from  15 minutes to 1 hour
The third penalty was changed from 30 minutes to 24 hours
The forth penalty was changed from 1 hour to 7 days
[/list]

notes.title: Reputation System Explained
notes.content:
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]
When we have developed MINDNIGHT back in 2017, we have developed it with a small team at No Moon, in a game jam. We had plenty of ideas of what we wanted to do back then while we were working on another game - a top-down melee multiplayer RPG (since then cancelled). We said a game jam, would take some steam off the team and get our creative heads active.

But we decided on MINDNIGHT - because it was close to our hearts - most of us played before social deduction games such as Werewolf and The Resistance. So we said - let's take The Resistance and try to adapt it to a digital format.

While developing the game, we had in our minds only the wholesome and deeply frustrating, but fun moments of these type of games. We hoped that people from all around the world would be able to experience that, but in a digital format - scaled well and wrapped up in a very cool concept, narrative and setting.

Fast forward now, after 2 years - we are very surprised what the game represents now and how a community was build around it. 

There is no question that the game still has many issues, many issues that we were unable to solve in time, or solve at all to this day. There is no question that parts of the games' community has become problematic due to harassment and toxicity. We never knew and we are still challenged each day by how we should handle this, since we are good at making games - not at managing communities. We tried to learn in time some things, but we are still nowhere near where we would like to be. 

For that being said, we wanted to start communicating with the community more, here on Steam, through regular posts so that we can explain our stance on different issues, explain new features and shed a light on our thought process and design decisions. Last but not least, we want this to also be an opportunity for everyone in the community to keep us in check, give feedback and discuss how we should shape MINDNIGHT in the game that you would like to play.

[h1]THE REPUTATION SYSTEM[/h1]
We have recently pushed a new update, the Halloween update, where we focused on content and we started doing some fixes and roll out new features.
One of the new features that we introduced partially is the REPUTATION SYSTEM.

[b]What is the reputation system?[/b]

Inspired by some other popular multiplayer online games, we decided to design and implement a reputation system that would allow you give other players likes and dislikes. Thumbs Up and Thumbs Down.
These binary ratings also have an underlying layer to them where they can split in several compliments or complaints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/97bbb95d957abf36eca2dbbb9869b65d0587c2a4.jpg[/img]

[b]Why add a reputation system[/b]

We wanted to add a reputation system for several reasons:
[olist][*] To encourage you to have a more positive behaviour, and respect one another
[*]To build a feature that will allows us in the future to have a better matchmaking
[*]To build a feature that can become a progression factor that motivates you to come back to the game constantly
[*]To award good play, nice behaviour and let community members inspire each other and cultivate a safe, friendly environment for new players[/olist]

Thumbs Up
[list][*]Friendly
For those of you that know how to behave, help others and are genuinely good with no toxicity lying under your skin.
[*]Communicative
For those of you that communicate well, politely and are focused on the game's objectives.
[*]Teamplayer
For those of you that simply play really well, collaborate well with others and can easily help the general cause of your team's objective objective[/list]

Thumbs Down
[list][*]Rude
For those of you that have a foul mouth and cannot stop harassing others with your ill-intended and noisy behaviour.
[*]Non-Communicative
For those of you, that simply do not communicate at all, or you communicate topics that have nothing to do with the objective and gameplay at hand.
[*]Gamethrower
For those of you that go against your objective, reveal your role and refuse to adapt to others and to your team's objective.[/list]

By all means, we do not consider these Reputation System ratings, perfect - nor final. Some of these, are arguable or borderline subjective. But we do want to make a few things clear about some of these ratings, especially the ones that then can transform into a unjust report.

[h1]Report System vs Reputation System[/h1]
Many of you have asked where is the report system, since it's not present at the end of a match anymore.

By introducing the Reputation System, we have also taken this opportunity to hide the report buttons under the Thumbs Down Function, making everyone not able to see the report button the first thing after they finish a game.

We all know how salty and frustrating some social deduction games tend to be in the end, and we decided not to have lots of report buttons on the screen, because as humans we are reactive and make bad decisions sometimes. When we introduced the Report System, we did not want it to become a center piece element of the end game. We wanted it to be there in order to let the community to self regulate itself.

By moving the report button behind the Thumbs Down function, we hope that we will see lower report numbers, and have players "punish" other players by using the Thumbs Down function without reporting. The report should be only used in extreme cases by all players.

As a consequence, after just a few days, we see a substantial decline in reports and bans - which we hope will help new players adapt to the game in a safer, more friendlier environment.

[h1]Expanding the Reputation System[/h1]
Now that we went through our motivations, thoughts and design decisions, we want to give you a glimpse in all of the gameplay elements that we are working on right now, in order to receive your thoughts and comments around them. These possible mechanics of the Reputation System, are work in progress and it's needless to say that they are final in any form.

It is important to know that right now the Reputation System does not communicate nor affect any other gameplay system.

The mechanics that we are thinking and working on adding to expand the Reputation System are:
[olist][*]PROFILE - Display the positive ratings of each player in the Profile Section (Stats)
[*]RATINGS - Adjust ratings and add definitions in-game for each, for a better understanding of what they mean, and their level of objectivity
[*]PROGRESSION - Introduce a progression system for the reputation, where you are able to go up and down on a scale, and have relevant titles and rewards awarded to them relative to their rating sum
[*]MATCHMAKING - As the player base grows, we hope that we are able to enable and add new filters to make a better matchmaking, in order to not just separate skill levels, but also separate 
[*]PUBLIC PROFILE - We would also like to introduce at some point a feature to expand the Profile Feature with the possibility of players to inspect other players' profile. In this expanded public profile we would like publicly show the positive ratings from the Reputation System [/olist]

We will now take our time and go through each and one of them and explain what we would like to do. As a disclaimer again - these are all work in progress designs, propositions and thoughts. We are working on some of them in implementation - but these are all subject to change.

[b]1. Player Profile + Reputation System[/b]

This is almost self-explanatory - but by adding the positive ratings in the player profile we will let players know, inspect and brag around about how awesome they are. Also when the progression will kick in - this will be even more relevant.

[b]2. Ratings and possible changes[/b]

The ratings that we have chosen now, might end up not being so popular among some players and we might change them in the future. We had some debates if we should put Polite vs Friendly, Rude vs Abusive etc.
It may be at the end of the day a semantic battle, but we would like to know your thoughts about it. 
We are thinking of not having Gamethrowing as a thumbs down, as that still has a lot of subjectivity and not a lot of players can define it well enough.

[b]3. Reputation Progression[/b]

The primary feature extension that we would like to add to the Reputation System is a progression, where players would be able to go up and down a scale as they receive positive and negative ratings.
Everyone would have 7 levels. Everyone would start on the Neutral Stance in the middle. As a player you would have 3 levels beneath Neutral, meaning a negative reputation level and 3 levels above Neutral, meaning a positive reputation level.
This is not a linear progression system and players can go up and down this range. Each reputation level would have a title and this would be publicly shown with badges at the end of each game.
Additionally we would like to add two more things to this feature:
[olist][*]Reputation Rewards - depending on your reputation level, you will receive unique rewards based on the title that you have
[*]Reputation Season - each 4 weeks the reputation levels will have a soft reset, until gaining new titles, reputation levels and badges and at the end of this season, rewards will be handed.[/olist]

[b]4. Reputation and Matchmaking[/b]

Furthermore, after we would introduce a reputation progression with relative levels, we can then say that this can reflect a player's behaviour and playstyle quite well. With enough players, to avoid long queues, we can apply a filter to the matchmaking and have negative players with a similar reputation level play with each other, while the positive rated players would play together.

[b]5. Public Profile[/b]
As initially we would only show the overall reputation level badge at the end of a game, we would like at some point, far in the future probably to add public profiles. Players would be able to inspect each others profiles and see different things including what positive ratings and how many each player has.
This will act like a motivation factor and make players compete for positive reinforcement. 

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
We are aware that the Reputation System does not solve all issues that the game have but we think this is a step towards a better game and community. We also know that we don't hold the universal truth and we don't make the best decisions all the time, that is why we want you, our community to keep us in check so we don't tunnel vision on some aspects and trigger a fuss around decisions made in our design cave with no contact outside in the real world.

These are all of the things that we wanted to share with you so far and we would love to have you part of the decisions, give us feedback and help us develop them in a sane way to create a better and safer environment in MINDNIGHT.

We would also like to hear your suggestions on how would you like us to communicate with you, and if you would like for us to do other things such as AMAs, Streams, Interview, Youtube Videos etc.

Please leave a comment below by hitting the discuss button and/or join our [url=https://discord.gg/nomoon]discord[/url] and be part of the discussion.

notes.title: 2.7.0 - Halloween Special Update + MINDNIGHT's 2 year anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30051285/d466e280bea06ac3b6af926b88b742fc6a693c6c.png[/img]

[h1]Happy Halloween! [/h1]
Time to carve out the agent, bring out the candies and let's get hacking.

We are introducing a super special update where we bring some changes, a new feature that will expand over time and lots of new skins and emoji.

Beside Halloween, here at No Moon, we are also celebrating the 2 year anniversary of MINDNIGHT, and we want to take this chance to thank you all for playing and supporting the game for so long - or just simply to welcome you in the MINDNIGHT family if you are new around the block.

These last two years were a real rollercoaster for us, trying to juggle the difficulties of a new start-up company, seek funding for other projects we have in the pipeline, freelancing or even having a full-time job with constantly being challenge by you our beloved community to keep the game alive, updated and fresh.
After 26 updates, we feel that we still did not scratch the entire vision that we had and we have for the game.

[h1]What we have in plan[/h1]
We still have many issues that we want to fix and many features that we still have in the backlog. We will bring these to you as soon as we can, and we also wanted to let you know that we are already working on some! Some of the things that are planned include:
[list]
[*]Improved and expanded Reputation System with Progression and Rewards
[*]Improved and expanded Vote History
[*]Extend the level cap and introduce new rewards for leveling up
[*]Add a play again button in the after game lobby
[*]Allow Key bindings to be changed in the settings menu
[*]New Maps (WIP)
[*]Scripted Tutorial
[*]Color-Blind Mode
[*]Gameplay rehauls to discourage and exterminate metagaming and metagaming harrasment
[*]Economy Retweaks
[*]Localization Support
[*]Mission System
[*]Draggable/Resizeable In-Game Chat Window
[*]Public Player Profiles
[/list]

[h1]Halloween 2.7.0[/h1]
Now let's see what we have in store in this new 2.7.0 - Halloween Update:

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]We have removed the role icons in-game to discourage meta-gaming, and we will continue to make changes to exterminate metagaming as much as possible
[*]The emojis are no longer unlocking through leveling up. Emojis are either available by default, or can be bought in the store.
[*]We have fixed an issue where some users experienced the game getting stuck when someone did not accept a match being found in the Main Menu
[*]We have fixed an issue where text overlaps in some areas in the UI
[/list]

[*][b]Reputation System[/b]

The Reputation system does not influence anything at this time, but we would like to update the feature in small steps and bring the rest of the system into place gradually.
We would like to find out if you enjoy this feature and if you think this brings value to MINDNIGHT and your gameplay experience.

  - Reputation progression to reflect a player’s level of good or bad behavior

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Map Background Contest - Community Creators Converge! Create a Map Background and win credits to last a lifetime and purchase all in-game content! Due to 22nd of July.
notes.content:
Scrape together, hoard the talented, forgather the pixels and cluster your ideas onto MINDNIGHT's first Map Contest.
Since the last Skin Community Creation contest, we have been asked hundreds of times when would we organize the next community contest. 

Here we are now! We hope you gathered all your strength and patience cause this will be a hard one. A lot of explanation to do and a lot of instructions to respect in order to qualify as being the Map BG King. In addition in winning a lot of In-Game Credits, your map will be implemented in the game and we will also send a shiny nice MINDNIGHT T-shirt to your house. It will smell of indie developers, we apologize in advance. You should wash it before wearing it. 

In order to participate you need to create a map background for MINDNIGHT in 2 weeks. 
The contest will be over on the 22nd of July.
Current map backgrounds are two, Subway and Backalley. You can see them [url=https://imgur.com/a/SjTcUfM]here[/url].

[h1]Technical instructions[/h1]

In order to create a map you need to know the following technical instructions:

[olist]
    [*]The map size in pixels is 789px X 338px
    [*]This size represent a wide version, in order for the background to support wide-screens
    [*][url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/9iffyu0dv92qwi0/background_contest.psd?dl=0]Here[/url] you can download a .psd, in case you use Photoshop. In the .psd you will be able to see the folowing layers:
[/olist]
- Subway_BG and BackAlley_BG for your reference
- Instructions layer group with: 16:9 Visible area on screens with that aspect ratio, a safezone of the Character Area aka where the skins and players reside with their chat bubbles and last but no least Players Layer, where you are able to see the layout of a full 8-man game session
- Also you will be able to see a HUD layer, where we have the HUD elements accordingly to a 1920 by 1080 resolution.

In order for the map to be eligible for the contest it needs to respect the size. 
The map can be created in any other software. 

In order to facilitate other community members creations in other software we have created [url=https://imgur.com/a/szVGa1f]this album[/url], with all of the layers separately in PNGs for your discretion to import them.

[h1]Artistic instructions[/h1]

There is not much to tell here, but we recommend in using the same perspective in order to keep the map consistent with other maps. The perspective that we are talking it's a one-point perspective where buildings and objects have their sides hidden and not visible. See the other two maps for your reference.

You have creative freedom as long as it does not contain nudity, sexual and religious themes or other subjects that are perceived as being controversial topics in the world right now. You cannot depict alive or dead characters or locations with religious or political meaning.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.2.2 - Machmaking with friends and Queue Times - Listening to your feedback
notes.content:
Hey there,

Thanks a lot for your recent response and feedback! We have done another hot fix, addressing some of the recent feedback that you, the community expressed in the last 24 hours. 

Explanations and reasoning behind the recent decisions that we've made are explained below the patch notes, including what we have done in this hotfix to address any issues that we had in the latest update.

For us it's very important to put all of our efforts in making MINDNIGHT a better game and listening to you feedback as fast as we can.

Last but not least, we apologize for any inconvience or ill intented feelings you had to put up with during the last major update 2.2.

Hotfix Patch Notes:

[list]
    [*]We have disabled the Level Based Matchmaking for now, to counter long queue times. 
This is a temporary solution, until we modify the system with a more versatile approach

    [*]We have re-added the Find Game button in Custom Game Lobbies, as a temporary solution until we will introduce the Party System.
When the Party system will be introduced, the Custom Game Lobbies will not be connected in anyway anymore, with any other game mode queue

    [*]Renamed Casual Mode to Quick Play to emphasize the fact that this is the quickest way to find a game, although some players may be queued up with players of different skill levels 
[/list]


[h1]Thought process, Reasoning and Future Plans[/h1]


After doing the recent update we have observed an incredible response from some of you and the amount of feedback that we received is overwhelming. Thanks a lot for your diligence and your effort to make the game better together with us. 

We have listened to your recent feedback regarding two main issues:

[olist]
    [*]Longer queue times because of the level based matchmaking in Casual Mode
    [*]Not being able to queue up with friends in Casual Mode from a Custom Game Lobby
[/olist]

We will go through both subjects and explain some of the elements and process behind our decision, and then we will conclude into explaining what we did with this Hotfix in order to address these issues for now.


[h1]Longer Queue Times/Level Based Matchmaking[/h1]

Our thought process of introducing a Level Based Matchmaking was to address the complaints from some of the players, having to play against or with players that are not similar to close to their skill level.

The only way to define someone's skill right now - is through the meta-game system. Levels. Using this, we have decided to make people queue up in groups of levels. Level 1-10, Level 10-20 and Level 20-30. 

This ensures that players of similar levels/skill will be queued together, and new players will have more room to learn in a safe environment without having to be called names for not knowing the subtlety of the game mechanics yet. 

At the same time, more experienced players are having better quality games, by playing with similar experienced players. 

We have foreseen the issue that we are confronting with now - longer queue times.
Because of the Level Based Matchmaking, players are now experiencing longer queue times, and sometimes can wait up to 10 minutes to find a game in their level group.

[b]Conclusion[/b] - As a temporary solution, the level-based matchmaking will be disabled, until we will develop the system in a more versatile way to accommodate the queue times. As a solution in the future we will try to modify the system so that when someone from a level group will wait more than X seconds, his level group will automatically be lowered, for shorter queue times. We will constantly listen to your feedback and let us know if this will feel good in the future.

notes.title: 2.2.0 Update Now Live - Automated Banning System, Join in Progress, New skin and emojis!
notes.content:
Hackers, Agents,

A much-expected update that we have delayed several times it's now love. We apologize for this late update, but we have worked very hard in refactoring the game's code, implement, fix and add new features to accommodate the current state of the game.

Thanks a lot for your patience and your help in improving the game together with us.

We have added a lot of things, and changed some elements in the game, but the most notable are the Automated Banning System, Penalty System and Join in Progress.

[h1]Automated Banning System[/h1]

We are receiving more than 800 reports daily right now, and for us, as a small team it is clear that we cannot curate the game fast enough and well enough without an automated system.

We will still ban players permanently manually for extreme cases, but depending on how many reports a player receives he will be banned incrementally from now on.

First time 15 minutes, the second time 30 minutes and so on. 
If you are not reported for a while after a first ban, the incrementation will reset. You can reach a ban of 10 days if you are banned constantly. Everyone can still be permanently banned if someone is getting reported too often by a lot of different players. We will get notified and we can apply a perma-ban manually.

A player is banned taking into account different factors such as: how often he is reported and by who. If another player reports players very often, his reports will not have the same value over time. This way we make sure that a player it's not banned because a player that reports others players with no reason. If a player received a report from another player, a second report from the same player will not be taken into account anymore for a while.

[h1]Join in Progress[/h1]

We all get disconnected from time to time or for some unexpected reason our power will turn off our computer. Now, players can rejoin the match in the maximum period of 5 minutes. 

In order to win a game, you need to be online at the end of the game. If you are not at the end of a game for any reason you will lose the game by default, together with any winning streak.

In the Main Menu, we also have now the option of Abandoning a game. By Abandoning a game, a Penalty will be activated.

[h1]AFK/Leaving Game Penalty System[/h1]

When a player abandons a game now consciously he will receive a penalty. 
The penalty will not allow a player to search for a new game anymore for 30 minutes. This time can change as we are experimenting and we are open to feedback. 

The penalty will be applied in the following cases: abandoning a game from inside the game and canceling the re-join option in the main menu and for when a player will not rejoin a game in the first 5 minutes.

The penalty also resets after a while and it is not permanent.


Now - the complete change list for 2.2.0:


[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

[list]
    [*]In order to accommodate the difference in skill between new players and more experienced players we are introducing level based matchmaking with 3 level groups - 1-10, 11-20, 21-30
    [*]When pressing the play button, players can now choose between Casual Mode and Custom Games. We are working on the Ranked Mode and this will be added at a later date
    [*]Added a new skin called Mr. Hacker
    [*]Added 4 new emojis - Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down, Thinking and a Heart
    [*]Players can now re-join in progress games in case of disconnection
    [*]AFK players will now be kicked out of the game
    [*]A penalty system now it's implemented to punish AFK players and players that abandon a game on purpose
    [*]Players are now automated banned when reported by a lot of players
    [*]Added two new names to the general name list used in Casual Mode that were submitted by two of our fellow patreons - Patrick and Nunya
    [*]Winter Custom Maps were added to Custom Games
    [*]Added an option to select the gender name before searching for a game.
    [*]Added a notification when planned maintenance will be announced before hand
    [*]Added a new splash screen with warning text about conversational gameplay, warning players about the nature of the game
    [*]Added spam protection for both global and in-game chat windows
    [*]The global chat now it's also accessible from a custom game lobby
    [*]Added the emoji selector in the global chat as well
    [*]Added Screensaver mode
[/list]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
    [*]AFK players are now  kicked out of a match. A player becomes AFK when not making an action two times in a row (e.g. a player did not propose a team and after that he did not accept the next team proposal)
    [*]We have improved several AI-Player behavior to prevent finding out their role
    [*]Disconnection messages in-game chat shows if a player left manually or by disconnect
    [*]The Find Game button was removed from Custom Games because this encourages meta-gaming and cheating. We are working on a Party System that will only work in Casual Mode in the future, with certain limitations
[/list]


[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where high ping caused FPS drops or freezing of the game
    [*]Fixed an issue when a steam invite was not working after a match was completed
    [*]Fixed an issue when a game lobby that was in progress did not close properly, and it was displayed in the custom game list
    [*]Fixed an issue when sometimes disconnected players were not detected by the game client
    [*]Fixed an issue where ASCII codes were breaking the chat
    [*]Fixed several game glitches when a match would end before a team won 3 missions
    [*]Fixed an issue where players would get disconnected on loading screen and the players would not get marked as being disconnected in-game
    [*]Fixed an issue where clicking on how to play and then pressing ESC would stop all the main menu music
    [*]Fixed an issue where ESC would make a player leave the lobby when a friend invite is open
    [*]Fixed an issue where disconnected players were getting experience and credits
    [*]Fixed an issue where the achievement "Finally, we caught them" was not working anymore
    [*]Fixed an issue where the experience sound was playing after the maximum level was reached
    [*]Fixed an issue where the report button at the end of a game would not be clickable when obscured by other UI elements
    [*]Fixed some typos in all menus
[/list]

Thank you for your support and help.

Let us know if you have any feedback related to this update on our discord, and do not hesitate to join our discord if you want to know more about the plans for the next updates.

Cheers,
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: Update 2.0.4 - Performance improvements, bug fixes and phase length adjustments
notes.content:
Sup hackerz?

We just updated the game with a few small changes and a lot of improvements both on the server and client side.

Thanks a lot to everyone that helped us find issues and bugs and for all of the reports. 
For those of you that want to contribute and help us improve the game going on, do not forget we have a very active Discord community [url=discord.gg/mindnight]here[/url]. 
Join us and let's make MINDNIGHT better together.

For the next period of time we will focus on the X-mas update that brings a few new features and themed content. ːsteamhappyː

Without further ado, these are the changes that we just pushed:

[h1]Gameplay changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] We have changed the lenght of the talking phases, and incremented them depending on which node the game is at a specific moment. The old value for all node talking phases was 70 seconds.

New values:
Node 1 Talking Phase - 30 seconds
Node 2 Talking Phase - 45 seconds
Node 3 Talking Phase - 60 seconds
Node 4 Talking Phase - 75 seconds
Node 5 Talking Phase - 90 seconds

Old Talking Phases Total Lenght - 350 Seconds (6 minutes)
New Talking Phases Total Lenght - 300 seconds (5 minutes)

We have made this change because it is in line with the amount of dialogue that is going on in each phase. The further the node, the more everyone has to talk about.

    [*]Added text colors for the following words to highlight words that are related to gameplay for both Agents and Hackers:

GREEN - secure, secures, secured, securing, agent, agents
RED - hack, hacks, hacked, hacking, hacker, hackers
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and improvements:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a general issue that glitched the server in several situations. There are situations where the problem might persist. If so, please help us identify them.
    [*]Fixed a high CPU usage issue when a lot of messages were sent in games
    [*]Fixed an issue when the Hide UI button was not instancing all menus and screens
    [*]Fixed an issue where when a player is too late for an lobby invite via Steam and clicks the invite later, the game was stuck in a functional loop.
    [*]We have fixed a potential exploit where a tooltip was different in the UI, making players know who were the hackers and who were the agents by asking what the tooltop sais. The tooltip caption was now replaced with a neutral tooltip for both Agents and Hackers.
    [*]Fixed the tooltip for the Reject mission button
    [*]Fixed an issue where names such as Hanna and Anna were not colored correctly.
    [*]Fixed an issue where a player was 2x hacker, leading to some matches in having 2 hackers instead of 3, for example.
[/list]


That's it for now! 

We are working on a lot of new features and content and we are constantly looking to fix the remaining issues.

Either way, thanks a lot for your support and for your generous reviews, although we had a lot of bugs and issues in the game.

Cheers!
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: Patch 2.0.3 - Leaderboars Temporary Change and Fixes
notes.content:
Hallo there MINDNIGHTERS,

After another week of crazy stuff, lots of suggestions and a bunch of new players in our community we are doing another small update, bigger than the last one in which we are making small changes and we are adressing some bugs and issues that were both known and/or reported by our players.

First of all we want to thank all of you for the support, perseverance and patience around the game as we are adressing some issues and preparing for big improvements in our upcoming X-mas 2.1.0 Update.

Here is a full list of the changes and for any other suggestions and issues that you have, join our [discord.gg/mindnight]Discord[/url] so we can chat, talk strategies and find games if you are in a different timezone than the current playerbase.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Temporary leaderboard sorting change - where now we are sorting the leaderboard not based on W/L ratios, but instead around how many wins. 
NOTE: This is a temporary improvement until we will polish the ELO system. Together with the ELO system we will most probably introduce soon after ranked games and unranked games but the is still TBD.
    [*]Added a small feature where gestures are now auto-completed when typing them
    [*]Added more name in the Funny Names list in Custom Games
    [*]Added a small feature where players can repeat a command by pressing the Up Arrow Key
    [*]Added Maintenance Mode to control when and how the server behaves while under maintenance.
    [*]Improved the disconnected player AI:
Now the AI will always vote Yes on the node team
Now the AI will always vote yes when on hammer
Now the Ai will vote randomly when not on a node team, minor role bias added
    [*]Improved server logging, where each phase will log in its room ID, thus showing errors better when multiple room are running
    [*]Improved statistics tools where we monitor additional in-game stats
    [*]Players now can send a message by also using the Numpad Enter Key
    [*]Players nicknames are now saved in Match History Server Data
[/list]


[h1]Fixed bugs and issues[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Partially fixed - An issue where game with disconnected players, started behaving uncontrollably.
    [*]Partially fixed - An issue where players found themselves in an endless loop in the selection phase
    [*]Fixed an issue where players would receive First Win of the Day, two times
    [*]Fixed issues with infinite looping sounds
    [*]Fixed a consistency issue where the scrollbars in the UI were not behaving in the same way in all menus
    [*]Fixed an issue where the chat would scroll at the last message where a new one would be received
    [*]Fixed a typo of "Strak" to "Streak" in the menus
    [*]Players that leave a match will also get a win or a lose in their match history and that match will affect their ranking.
    [*]Fixed an issue where emoji image tage would get colored and bugged
[/list]

Thanks and see you in-game, HACKER!
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.title: Free to Play MINDNIGHT 2.0 Live!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

The wait is over. We are now Free to Play and we would like to thank everyone that helped in this transition. 

All players that already own the game will be properly compensated with In-Game Credits, that can be used to purchase Skins, Emoji or Gestures.
If you have any issues do not hesitate to contact us.

Together with this we are also releasing a big update with the following changes:

Join our discord here - https://discord.gg/mindnight

TL;DR: Progression System, Over 18 Skins, lots of Emoji, Gestures, In-Game Credits, matchmaking improvements...and more.

[list]
    [*]Reworked the Main menu and now features a more straightforward way to search for a game, and access all of the other menus present in the game
    [*]Added Profile and Stats section, where we show your stats, match history, achievements list and your collectibles progression
    [*]Added Global Chat in the Main menu, together with Find-A-Game separate chat room
    [*]Added Skins, the ability to change the character that appears while playing
    [*]Added Emoji, can be used during chat, full list in-game. For example: :) (Smile Emoji)
    [*]Added Gestures, can be used during game-play to trigger an animation on your character. It work with any skin. For example: /laugh (Laughing animation trigger)
    [*]Added Marketplace, where player can purchase with in-game credits Skins, Emoji and Gestures.
    [*]Added Credits, that can be acquired through game-play but also through micro-transactions
    [*]Improved the overall functionality of Custom Games
    [*]Changed the maximum number of player from 10 to 8 to balance the game more
    [*]Added Community external links section and announcement sections to the Main Menu
    [*]Added Leaderboards, where players can see their position world wide and see the Top Players
    [*]Added a How To Play Video that can be accessed through the Main Menu button
    [*]Added Progression system, where the player can now level up by playing games, and from time to time, rewards will be unlocked. The maximum level is 30 right now.
    [*]Added a Rules of Conduct button, that redirects the player to an external page, covering the rules of the game that need to be followed in order to avoid being suspended or banned from the game
    [*]Added a tracking system where we can see abusive players and ban them
    [*]Added a new gameplay map called Backalley. Players will be matchmaked randomly on a map or they can choose in Custom Games what map they would like to play
    [*]Added a Connecting Screen, when players have difficulties connecting to the server
    [*]We have reworked the Matchmaking system to facilitate more players finding games

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Going Free-to-play - Nov 30th, New website and Expanding Community
notes.content:
Hello fellow Agents, Hackers and Wish listers,

We apologize for not doing more frequent updates, but we are looking at changing that from now on. As we are moving forward with the development of MINDNIGHT we would like to go through some subjects that are very important for us regarding going free-to-play, launching a new website for the game, expanding the community in a number of ways and adding new features to the game.


[h1] Going Free-to-play[/h1]

[h1] TL; DR - We will go Free-to-Play starting 30th of November [/h1]

Being our first published game, we believe we have learned a lot from this experience and we will constantly improve our pipeline for our other more ambitious games.

The recent narrative about pay-to-win games have also let us realize that sometimes it is not important on how much a game is worth, but what is important is that we want to share our work with as many players as possible that want to play our game, and they cannot right now because various reasons.

Pay-to-win is a flawed concept, overused by game designers of free-to-play games. We believe that this kind of systems create bad habits and toxic behaviors. Spending to be good at a game should not be an option and we believe if someone will want to spend money on a game, they should not be forced in doing so.
Manipulating human behavior is not what games are about, it's about triggering emotions, having fun and getting people together.

Therefore, we decided to make MINDNIGHT, free-to-play with no microtransactions that will affect the gameplay in anyway. The only possible spending can be done only to customize your experience through unique additional visuals such as skins, emoji and gestures. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/8d10095a58d0d7e6081f1ae7a1839119e0075593.jpg[/img]

We are working to define compensation for the current players that have bought the games, and this will most probably translate into Coins in-game that can be used to buy skins, emoji and gestures to use in the game once the update is live


[h1] Update 2.0 - New Features[/h1]

For the last 2 months we worked hard into creating a more interesting gameplay loop by adding improvements to the current gameplay, add new features and fix many bugs that we encountered since launch. With your help we have found a lot of bugs and we are proud to announce that we fixed most of them!

Firstly, we have added a number of [b]Visual Customization[/b] options to the game that we believe it will make your experience more fun and interesting by choosing to use one of the 18 skins, type in chat with newly implemented emoji and spice up things in-game with new gesture animations that can be accessed by typing in chat /cry, /facepalm etc.

Skins, Emoji and Gestures can be unlocked through leveling up, or buying them from the Marketplace. These do not affect gameplay at all and we are not planning in doing something in this regard. Do not worry thought, there are some skins, emoji and gestures that are already unlocked from the start of the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/77c90cf29edad04da86e4ad4bf1c846cc1cf676c.jpg[/img]

We will also constantly update the game with new skins, emoji and gestures. 

Secondly, we have added a [b] Progression System [/b], through which you can now level up your account from 1 to 30. You can level up by playing games and acquiring experience. From time to time you will unlock rewards such as emoji, gestures and skins from level to level.

Together with the progression system we now have a [b]Leaderboard[/b], where the best players are shown. You are also able to see your rank in this screen in comparison to other players.

There are a lot of new features that we added, but the ones explained above are the most important. 

Other features that we implemented are:
[list]
    [*] New Main Menu
    [*] Profile and Stats
    [*] Global Chat in Main Menu
    [*] Friend List in Main Menu
    [*] Player Database and Tracking System
....and more
[/list]
We will release a full Patch Notes announcement, once we release the Update 2.0.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/7e0cea6cbe09d69da919fba059d5d79282447319.jpg[/img]

As we heard complaints and we have seen users abusing and taking advantage of their anonymity we decided to work on a Reporting System, that will come a bit later. This will make sure that abusive players will face consequences and even be banned from the game if they do not respect other players. We are also working on integrating Voice Chat for custom games. Both these two features will not be available in Update 2.0.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/c2be373505a016634bee7bc109f96dc5ee1ebed9.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Website and Expanding Community[/h1]

We have worked on a new website for the game that turned out really beautiful. Here is a sneak peak:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/ed4a487657de30f58f06e67f5c194532f7a03d76.jpg[/img]

Together with this we are also expanding the ways the community can interact with us and discuss strategies. 

We have created a subreddit, where we will post announcements and discuss further updates.

We are also opening up a Patreon page to let some players that wish to support us, get involved in development and help us cover server and marketing costs.

We are also working on a Wiki Page where we will explain everything that is in game, from features, gameplay to skins and lore.

Last but not least, we have a How to Play video ready to be integrated in the game and published on our pages for players that are new, to get accustomed with the concept.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/456b01f36e94c8f4783a91b291d5efdfe17aa83a.jpg[/img]

We also have a new trailer, that it's 10x better than the first one. We hope this will help the game have more hackers and agents! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30051285/c5c5e9f006bda063c2bf96805d5b607cba75b0de.jpg[/img]

That being said, I hope you can support us next week into transitioning to Free-to-play, sharing our new trailers and start having fun in some deceiving games of MINDNIGHT.

Thanks for being with us, this helps us a lot to move forward and try to do our best in development.

Cheers!
MINDNIGHT TEAM

notes.content:
Hello there hackers..or agents...

We are moving forward with our quick updates to improve the overall experience and prepare the game for some bigger changes that we are working on currently.

[/list]

Thanks again for being with us and we also wanted to tell you that your patience, understanding, and help mean a lot to us as we are looking to update the game with a meta-game, add skins and ways to customize the experience.

Cheers!
MINDNIGHT Team

notes.content:

More so, as we are going through the first days of our release, we would also like to apologize for the long occasional matchmaking queues. For these times when it is difficult to find a match we created a discord channel so that we can gather more people in our community. In this discord channel you will be able to discuss with developers, find and create matches and discuss strategies with other players.

You can access the discord channel - https://discord.gg/MdTTSKA 

Thank you for your understanding and your support.

[*]The How to Play button that redirects players to the How to Play screen was moved in the Main Menu
[*]The matchmaking system has been slightly changed. While finding a game, the matchmaking will continue until a match is found or matchmaking canceled by the player

More so, as we are going through the first days of our release, we would also like to apologize for the long occasional matchmaking queues. For these times when it is difficult to find a match we created a discord channel so that we can gather more people in our community. In this discord channel you will be able to discuss with developers, find and create matches and discuss strategies with other players.

You can access the discord channel - https://discord.gg/MdTTSKA
